sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:16

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:16:1
items.html: Two breaches: the first through the Parsa, and the second through the walls of the vessels of AK: For the first breach was made for the need of the NHY of AK themselves. The Parsa was bounding and concluding the Atzilut of SAG, so that no light at all should descend any longer from the Parsa downward, and the vessels of ZON that are in these NHY were empty of light. And now, through the second coupling of AB and SAG, this boundary of the Parsa was annulled, as above in the adjacent item; and then the lights that are drawn from this coupling expanded once more into the vessels of ZON that are there. And this is the first breach. And the second breach was made for the need of Nekudim, that is, through the Tabur and the Yesod, in that those lights of ZON of the inner AK shone to the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, as will be written below.
